summary: Evogene Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and TASE, disclosed via Form 6-K and attached press release that Nasdaq granted an additional 180-calendar-day period, through March 29, 2027, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Nasdaq Rule 5550(a)(2). The initial deficiency notice came March 30, 2026, with the first cure window ending September 28, 2026. Compliance requires a $1.00 closing bid for ten consecutive business days; failure triggers delisting notice. The company floats a possible reverse share split as a cure. Watch for a split announcement or renewed deficiency.
